title: George Stephanopoulos, 65, Poses With Wife Ali Wentworth and Their Two Daughters Elliot, 24, and Harper, 21, for Career Milestone

 The presenter received a Walk of Fame star.
 Meg Walters Fri, 6 November 2026 at 4:05 pm UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Credit: Getty The Gist
 George Stephanopoulos received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame November 5.
 He was joined by his wife Ali Wentworth and their daughters Elliot and Harper.
 Elliot recently graduated from Brown and Harper is a student at Vanderbilt University.
 George Stephanopoulos celebrated a major career milestone—and his family was there to support him. The Good Morning America presenter was honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame on November 5. His wife Ali Wentworth and their daughters Elliot, 24, and Harper, 21, were there in coordinated looks. Stephanopoulos wore a cobalt blue suit with a pale pink shirt. His wife also wore a pale pink blouse with navy pants. His daughters stuck to the color scheme, too, one wearing a navy dress with lace trim and the other opting for a dusy rose pink silk tea dress with lace detailing.
 George Stephanopoulos and his family at the Walk of Fame ceremony. 
 Credit: Getty 
 "This is one of those never could've imagined moments," Stephanopoulos said during the ceremony, per People . "But really, being at Good Morning America , I feel like that just about every day…"
 Ali Wentworth and George Stephanopoulos. 
 Credit: Getty 
 "The chance to cover the biggest, most consequential stories of our time, to interview the most interesting and inspiring people of our time, to be able to say good morning to the entire country every morning, not knowing what they're going through, but trying to help guide them with the information, the advice that they need to get their day started and maybe put a smile on their face, as well, that is a great gift," he added.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Stephanopoulos and Wentworth married in 2001. They welcomed Elliot the next year and Harper followed in 2005.
 Last year, Elliot graduated from Brown University. "We have a college graduate!!! Congratulations to Elliott, and to the entire class of 2025. We love you and are so proud of you, E!" Stephanopoulos wrote on Instagram at the time.
 As for Harper, she's a student at Vanderbilt University. In 2023, Stephanopoulos took viewers along as he dropped her off at the school. "It's a huge adventure for Harper," he said. "She's never lived in Nashville before and the campus was amazing."
 He also opened up about becoming an empty nester. "Ali and I met and got married within nine months, and had a baby nine months later, so we've never known a house without kids really," he said, adding that they were "a little nervous, but excited too."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "I know our daughter will thrive. But man, it's brutal on the parents," Wentworth wrote on Instagram at the time. "If you feel inclined- please send me baked goods. I'll be under my covers."
 George Stephanopoulos and his daughters.
